repo_triage._comment: Surfaces open PRs/issues NOT opened by github_handle, and threads where someone replied after your last comment. Uses self_repo. 'since' each run = previous last_run. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in the scheduled env to raise rate limits.

self_features: Secure HTML parsing via HTMLParser2 + XSS-safe defaults (protocol allowlist, on* handler stripping)
First-class marked extensions: KaTeX, Mermaid, Shiki, GitHub Alerts, Footnotes
Opt-in Shiki highlighting, tree-shaken out of core
LLM streaming mode with incremental rendering + streaming-aware sanitization
streamId prop to reset state between streams
Smart image lazy loading with fade-in
non_goals: WYSIWYG / editor functionality (this is a renderer, not an editor)
A bundled full DOM sanitizer (DOMPurify etc.) — ships safe-by-default URL/attribute sanitization only; full sanitization is the consumer's responsibility

watchlist.note: Svelte 5 port of Vercel Streamdown; same AI-streaming niche; incremental render via fine-grained reactivity
batteries-included: first-party Shiki + KaTeX + beautiful-mermaid, streaming-oriented

seo._comment: Cross-references the local GSC export (dropped in gsc_dir, gitignored) with Ahrefs to produce keyword/blog/site-fix recommendations. Nudges for a fresh export past gsc_staleness_days.
seo._tracked_keywords_comment: Exported from Ahrefs Rank Tracker project 8934907 on 2026-09-03 before cancelling the subscription. volume/kd/position are a point-in-time snapshot — kd especially is not reproducible from free sources. This is the curated target list; GSC now supplies ongoing position/impression movement.

page_validation._comment: compare-data.ts drives the /compare 'vs' pages (12 competitors incl. editors/parsers/preprocessors beyond the renderer watchlist). Validator checks svelte_peer for framework claims, hardcoded download figures, and them: feature cells on version bumps.

benchmarks.command: pnpm build && pnpm preview  (then, in another shell) pnpm perf:stream-compare
benchmarks.measures: streaming perf claims on the page: 'Nx faster under burst backpressure', DOM-footprint element counts, p95/throughput
benchmarks._comment: Perf numbers are only valid for the pinned devDep version. When svelte-streamdown publishes past measured_against, flag the page and prompt a human to bump the devDep + re-run the script. Do NOT auto-run in the nightly job.
